title: 86'd
description: A fine-dining chef cashes in on his bad luck — a silent, surreal comedy about ambition and consequence, directed by Jacob Willett and starring musicians Riston Diggs as the chef and Primo Dirty as the thief. Told without dialogue and scored entirely with Riston Diggs' own music from his EP "People of The World," alternating between the lyrical and instrumental versions of "Nothing to Prove," "Soldier," and "Signs of Time." Shot one week before "Stuck in the Desert."
